question: How many active subscriptions are currently on the enterprise tier plan?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM subscriptions AS s JOIN plans AS p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE s.status = 'active' AND p.tier = 'enterprise';

question: List the customer company names that had invoices with discount greater than 50 dollars.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name FROM customers AS c JOIN subscriptions AS s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id JOIN invoices AS i ON s.subscription_id = i.subscription_id WHERE i.discount_amount_usd > 50;
